messages:
maria: Heads up — customer reported SIEM ingest drops when we send webhook payloads > 256KB. Ticket #C-4332. They see truncated message field and missing kms_key_id header.
ajay: Can you paste the raw event they got?
maria: here (sanitized):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "type": "api.call",
  "user": "acct-123",
  "message": "...truncated..."
}
```
sam_ops: Do they use webhook or S3 export?
maria: Webhook to their Splunk HEC. We also export to their S3 bucket, and S3 files look complete.
ajay: That suggests our webhook HTTP body gets truncated by proxy or we set Content-Length wrong. Also the missing kms header means our signer might be dropping on retry path.
secbot: Note from last week: audit service uses header `X-Redwood-Audit-Version` and `X-Redwood-KMS-Key` for delivered payloads. If those headers are absent consumer should fallback to event metadata.
maria: Customer says they didn't see X-Redwood-KMS-Key. They did see signature header but signature validation failed (our logs: sig mismatch).
ajay: Two parallel workstreams: 1) investigate truncation between our webhook sender -> edge proxy -> customer HEC 2) verify headers + signing path esp. retry/redirect flows.
ajay: Quick checklist:
- ensure `Content-Length` matches gzipped payload when we set `Content-Encoding: gzip`
- include `X-Redwood-Audit-Version: audit.v3` and `X-Redwood-Event-Id` on every delivery
- include `X-Redwood-KMS-Key` and `X-Redwood-Signature-V1` headers
- add `raw_payload_size` in JSON body for debugging
maria: Can we bump the schema to audit.v3 to include `raw_payload_size` and `compressed` fields? That would help SIEMs to detect truncation without relying only on headers.
ajay: Yes — schema change OK but must be backwards compatible. Plan: add optional fields, keep `audit.v2` accepted. Add header `X-Redwood-Audit-Version` and a compatibility flag `X-Redwood-Accept-Backward: true` for older consumers.
sam_ops: For rollout: gate behind feature-flag, start with staging -> small customer subset -> all webhooks. Monitor 4xx/5xx spike.
secbot: RBAC note: only `audit-delivery-service` role should be allowed to call our webhook retry endpoint and S3 presign endpoints. Add a check in authz that rejects calls with any other principal.
ajay: Also we should sign the payload using a rotating key and publish verifier public keys at `https://audit.redwood.pub/keys.json` so customers can validate; include `kid` on signature header.
maria: Dev request: can eng-infra add an e2e test that posts a ~512KB event to our webhook pipeline and asserts HEC receives whole payload and headers intact?
sam_ops: I'll add job to `infra/tests/audit-delivery-e2e` and put a Canary that runs hourly for configured customers.
secbot: Vulnerability triage: if signature fails repeatedly for a customer, mark incident P2 and run the delivery-signer playbook. We logged the failure and created internal issue #SEC-789.
secbot: Also update incident runbook to include steps: repro with signed payload, compare raw_payload_size, check gzip headers, check proxy timeouts, verify key rotation window.
maria: docs + onboarding needed: update onboarding checklist to require customer's SIEM to accept `Content-Encoding: gzip`, `Transfer-Encoding` not chunked, and to whitelist our IP range.
ajay: For S3 exports: include both object metadata keys `redwood-audit-version`, `redwood-kms-key`, and a manifest JSON in the prefix with `events` list so SIEMs that read S3 can validate.
secbot: deploy-bot: rolled out audit-schema v3 to staging at 1801234800 :rocket:
ajay: After staging tests pass we'll do canary 5 customers then full rollout. I'll own the rollout and post results here.
maria: thx — i'll respond to customer with ETA and mitigation (switch to S3 export or enable retry with signature verification off temporarily)
sam_ops: note: add telemetry metric `audit.delivery.truncated` and alert if >0.1% over 10m.
ajay: assigning followups: @sam_ops add e2e test, @ajay do signer verification audit, @maria coordinate with customer, @secbot update runbook.
maria: ack.
